description: What's new: every change a user would notice, one plain sentence in every configured language (locales.json), newest first. Add entries with every release. id: one higher than the highest so far, never reused (re-read the file before choosing). date: yyyy-MM-dd, the day it was built; set to the release day when tagged. release: null until released, then the release version (scripts/release-tag.mjs). area: one of 'areas'. No internal names, ticket or migration numbers, or jargon; name things as the screens do in each language.
